name: CDC
description: Continuous writes with changefeed consumer measuring event processing rate

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bench_accounts (id INT8 PRIMARY KEY, name STRING NOT NULL, balance DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())

operations.name: cdc_write
sql: UPSERT INTO bench_accounts (id, name, balance) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
